step1_analysis.circuit_type: Fully Differential Current-Mirror Operational Transconductance Amplifier (OTA)
step1_analysis.description: This circuit is a fully differential OTA consisting of an NMOS input differential pair (XM1A/B) with diode-connected PMOS loads (XM2A/B). The currents are mirrored to the output branches via PMOS mirrors (XM3A/B), working against constant NMOS current source loads (XM4A/B). It provides high output impedance and is typically used in open-loop configurations or with a common-mode feedback (CMFB) circuit.

paper_reference.title: Device Mismatch and Tradeoffs in the Design of Analog Circuits

power_consumption.description: Total DC power consumption of the OTA.

paper_reported.value: 1W / 6W (Note: likely refers to a larger system in the paper)

sky130_expected.calculation: Tail current I_tail = 0.5 * 270u * 10 * (0.54-0.42)^2 = 19.4uA. The output branches mirror half the tail current each (9.7uA). Total current = 19.4uA + 2*9.7uA = 38.8uA. Power = 1.8V * 38.8uA = 70uW.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Calculated based on VBIAS=0.54V and typical SKY130 NMOS threshold voltages.

sky130_expected.calculation: Gm = 2 * (9.7uA) / 0.084V = 230 uA/V. Rout = ro_pmos || ro_nmos = 1.03MOhm || 515kOhm = 343 kOhm. Gain = Gm * Rout = 78.9 V/V = 38 dB.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Derived from the transconductance of the input pair and the parallel output resistance of the mirror and load transistors.

ugbw.description: Unity gain bandwidth with a 1pF load capacitance.

sky130_expected.calculation: UGBW = Gm / (2 * pi * C_load) = 230uA/V / (2 * pi * 1pF) = 36.6 MHz.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Directly proportional to the input pair Gm and inversely proportional to the load capacitance.

phase_margin.description: Phase margin at the unity gain frequency.

sky130_expected.calculation: Single-stage OTA with the dominant pole at the output node. The non-dominant pole at the current mirror node is at a much higher frequency.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Standard behavior for a single-stage OTA driving a relatively large 1pF load.

slew_rate.description: Maximum rate of change of the differential output voltage.

sky130_expected.calculation: SR = I_out_max / C_load. The maximum charging/discharging current available to the load is half the tail current (9.7uA). SR = 9.7uA / 1pF = 9.7 V/us.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Limited by the tail current and the 1:1 current mirror ratio.

sky130_expected.calculation: CMRR = Ad / Acm. In a perfectly symmetric schematic simulation, Acm is near zero.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Simulation without mismatch yields artificially high CMRR. Real-world CMRR would be limited by device mismatch.

input_offset_voltage.description: Input-referred offset voltage due to random device mismatch.

sky130_expected.calculation: Mismatch is inversely proportional to sqrt(W*L). For W=5u, L=0.5u (Area=2.5um^2), Vth mismatch is typically a few millivolts.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Matches the paper's reported 6mV, which is a realistic expectation for this device area in 130nm.

step3_testbench.description: Testbench to measure DC power, differential AC gain, UGBW, phase margin, CMRR, and transient slew rate. Large inductors are used to set the output DC operating point to VDD/2 (acting as an ideal CMFB) without loading the AC signal.
step3_testbench.spice:
* Fully Differential OTA Testbench
.lib "${SKY130_PDK}" tt

* Parameterized W/L
.param W_xm3a=5u L_xm3a=0.5u
.param W_xm4a=5u L_xm4a=0.5u
.param W_xm2a=5u L_xm2a=0.5u
.param W_xm2b=5u L_xm2b=0.5u
.param W_xm3b=5u L_xm3b=0.5u
.param W_xm5=5u L_xm5=0.5u
.param W_xm1b=5u L_xm1b=0.5u
.param W_xm1a=5u L_xm1a=0.5u
.param W_xm4b=5u L_xm4b=0.5u

* DUT
XM3A VOUTP N2 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm3a} w={W_xm3a}
XM4A VOUTP VBIAS GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm4a} w={W_xm4a}
XM2A N2 N2 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm2a} w={W_xm2a}
XM2B N0 N0 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm2b} w={W_xm2b}
XM3B VOUTN N0 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm3b} w={W_xm3b}
XM5 N1 VBIAS GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm5} w={W_xm5}
XM1B N0 VINN N1 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm1b} w={W_xm1b}
XM1A N2 VINP N1 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm1a} w={W_xm1a}
XM4B VOUTN VBIAS GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm4b} w={W_xm4b}

* Power and Bias
VVDD VDD 0 1.8
VVBIAS VBIAS 0 0.54

* Input Signals (Common-mode and Differential)
V_IN_CM IN_CM 0 DC 0.9 AC 0
V_IN_DIFF IN_DIFF 0 DC 0 AC 1 PULSE(-0.5 0.5 10n 1n 1n 1u 2u)

E_VINP VINP 0 vol='v(IN_CM) + 0.5*v(IN_DIFF)'
E_VINN VINN 0 vol='v(IN_CM) - 0.5*v(IN_DIFF)'

* Ideal CMFB / DC Biasing using Inductors
L1 VOUTP VCM 1000H
L2 VOUTN VCM 1000H
VCM VCM 0 0.9

* Load Capacitors
C1 VOUTP 0 1p
C2 VOUTN 0 1p

* Dummy node for differential output measurement
E_DIFF VOUT_DIFF 0 vol='v(VOUTP) - v(VOUTN)'

.control
  * 1. DC Operating Point for Power
  op
  let power = -i(VVDD) * 1.8
  print power

  * 2. AC Analysis - Differential
  ac dec 100 1 1G
  let gain_db = vdb(VOUT_DIFF)
  let phase = 180/PI * cph(v(VOUT_DIFF))
  meas ac dc_gain find gain_db at=10
  meas ac ugbw when gain_db=0 fall=1
  meas ac pm_phase find phase when gain_db=0 fall=1
  let phase_margin = pm_phase + 180
  print dc_gain ugbw phase_margin

  * 3. AC Analysis - Common Mode (for CMRR)
  alter V_IN_DIFF ac=0
  alter V_IN_CM ac=1
  ac dec 100 1 1G
  let gain_cm_db = vdb(VOUT_DIFF)
  meas ac cm_gain find gain_cm_db at=10
  let cmrr_db = dc_gain - cm_gain
  print cmrr_db

  * 4. Transient Analysis for Slew Rate
  alter V_IN_DIFF ac=1
  alter V_IN_CM ac=0
  tran 1n 2u
  * Measure time to slew 1V (from -0.5V to +0.5V)
  meas tran t_rise trig v(VOUT_DIFF) val=-0.5 rise=1 targ v(VOUT_DIFF) val=0.5 rise=1
  let sr_rise_vus = 1e-6 / t_rise
  
  * Measure time to slew 1V (from +0.5V to -0.5V)
  meas tran t_fall trig v(VOUT_DIFF) val=0.5 fall=1 targ v(VOUT_DIFF) val=-0.5 fall=1
  let sr_fall_vus = 1e-6 / t_fall
  
  print sr_rise_vus sr_fall_vus
  quit
.endc
.end
